rules: development (Capture_1): existing Stage 1-4 outputs; code is developed and checked here.
adjustment (Capture_2): the only capture on which any parameter may be adjusted.
final_evaluation (Capture_3, Capture_4): untouched until one final evaluation with a frozen config.

prior_use.Capture_1: Stage 1-4 development runs; Stage 3 fit of depth far plane and vertical FOV against reference 3D boxes.
prior_use.Capture_2: Stage 3 held-out depth/intrinsics test only. No parameter has been adjusted on it.
